evals.prompt: List all Auth0 clients and their active connections
expectations: Uses get_clients action to list applications
Uses get_connections action to list identity providers
Returns structured JSON with client names, types, and grant types

evals.prompt: Find all Auth0 users with acme.com email addresses and list enabled rules
expectations: Uses get_users action with q parameter email:*@acme.com
Uses get_rules action with enabled true
Redacts sensitive fields like client_secret and passwords
